items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: He put him in there with Sarah, all the big stars.

ctx.x: hundred dollars a week. And then, the next thing he did, he put him in there... The only time he put Dizzy in there, he put him in there with other stars. He didn't put him in there to draw the weight all by himself. He put him in there with Sarah, all the big stars. And he packed the joint. That's what really got him started out.
I was with Dizzy... You know where he got that idea of that horn?
